data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'antos', meaning 'flower' or 'grace'. In Christianity, St. Antony is a revered monk and hermit known for his grace and devotion. The name Antun carries the meaning “Graceful, Gentle” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Antun usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, gentle and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Antun total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

The name Antun serves as an inspiration for spiritual growth and a reminder of the importance of faith and devotion.
